changed_lines.after: Private Conversation’s discovery asset is the flat [`chim-plugin.tar.gz`](https://github.com/Francisco-boop-001/CHIM-PrivateConversation/releases/download/private_conversation-v0.1.25/chim-plugin.tar.gz). The table entry above is the wrapped legacy `private_conversation.tar.gz` route; CHIM’s repository installer strips that configured wrapper, so users should not unpack it by hand. The published BETA release has `prerelease=false` so CHIM can discover it; that flag is a filter, not a maturity certification.
